svg.title: Accuracy against serving cost
svg.desc: One point per judge: accuracy against the estimated serving cost of a thousand verdicts, at the quick verdict, or at 8,192 tokens for judges that always reason. Phi-4 (14B) reaches 90.16% for $0.34 and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 90.30% for $10.83; the two are equivalent within ±0.5 points. A large judge's quick verdict costs 9 to 32 times as much as Phi-4's.
svg.text: Accuracy against the estimated cost of a thousand verdicts
One point per judge: its quick verdict (B = 10), or B = 8,192 if it always reasons (ring)
16 small and 6 large judges, one point each
estimated serving cost per 1,000 verdicts, US$ (log scale)
Bottom strip: the eight judges below 84%. The leaderboard lists every judge.
a large judge's quick verdict costs 9 to 32× as much
